description_en: Queries the excluded directories of the anti-ransomware system

name: DescribeExcludeSystemPath

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page when paging is used for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示

ExcludePaths.description_en: The list of system excluded directories

Os.description_en:

linux: Linux.
windows: Windows
Os.description_zh:
服务器的操作系统。取值：
